How to update the custom MONACO editor for Node-RED
----------------------------------------------------

The vendored Monaco build is produced by
[nr-monaco-build](https://github.com/node-red/nr-monaco-build). Each release has the
built files attached as `nr-monaco-<version>.zip`. Current build:
[0.57.0](https://github.com/node-red/nr-monaco-build/releases/tag/0.57.0).

### Download the release

Download `nr-monaco-<version>.zip` from the release page and unzip it. It contains
`monaco/dist` and `types`.

### Copy the built versions into Node-RED

    cp -r nr-monaco-<version>/monaco/dist/. \
        <node-red-source-directory>/packages/node_modules/@node-red/editor-client/src/vendor/monaco/dist/

    cp -r nr-monaco-<version>/types/. \
        <node-red-source-directory>/packages/node_modules/@node-red/editor-client/src/types/

### Building it yourself

Only needed to try changes that are not in a release yet.

    git clone https://github.com/node-red/nr-monaco-build.git
    cd nr-monaco-build
    npm install
    npm run build

The output is in `output/monaco/dist` and `output/types`; copy those as above.
